description: Land Acquisition - Kongahagedara, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels (Lot No. 01 and 2), their boundaries, extents, and the legal process for acquisition. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel or structural changes mentioned.
